items.caption: A modern vector rendering of 人 in Shuowen seal-script style. 人 is the full form associated with the positional component 亻 in 們; this image does not show an early form of 們.
items.alt: Seal-script-style rendering of 人, with a horizontal top stroke and two descending strokes.
items.selection_reason: The image illustrates the documented 人-to-亻 positional relationship relevant to one component of 們. It is scoped to that relationship and does not establish 們’s graphic history.

limitations.text: No character-specific early form or graphic sequence for 們 is established. The image shows 人 alone as a modern rendering, not an ancient artifact or an early form of 們.
